BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: VI
BRANCH: CSE   SESSION : SP/2020

SUBJECT : CS6011 COMPUTER GRAPHICS & MULTIMEDIA

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) Explain the term resolution used in computer graphics.  [2]
 (b) Explain beam penetration model for producing color.  [3]


Q2 (a) What is bitmap?  [2]
 (b) Discuss various flat panel displays.  [3]


Q3 (a) What is the disadvantage of DDA algorithm?  [2]
 (b) Write down Bresenham line drawing algorithm. [3]


Q4 (a) Discuss the similarity used in midpoint circle drawing algorithm. [2]
 (b) Discuss only the features of ellipse drawing algorithm.

[3]


Q5 (a) Explain the benefits of homogeneous coordinates system?   [2]
 (b) Show that two successive translations are additive in nature in homogenous coordinate
system.
[3]


Q6 (a) Draw the diagram of 2D viewing pipeline.  [2]
 (b) Perform scaling transformation of the triangle as expressed by vertices  (1,1), (2,3), (3,2)
by  a  factor  2  along  X  axis  and  3  along  Y  axis  keeping  the  vertex  (1,1)  fixed  using
Homogeneous coordinates system.
[3]

Q2 (a) Describe about direct storage tubes in CG. [2]

Q3 (a) Write  a  second-degree  equation  which  describe  a  conic  section.  Write  the  particular

. [3]

 (b) Write the mid-point circle generating algorithm. [3]


Q5 (a) List the importance of homogeneous coordinate on CG transformations. [2]

Q6 (a) Write the significance of World coordinate system in CG. [2]
 (b) Write the Liang Barsky line clipping algorithm. Explain with examples. [3]
